entries.title: Centrifugal-pump stepped shaft
notes: Dimensioned shaft drawing, overall length 593 mm; source also describes slots/keyways.
Static FEM: downward displacement -4.838 micrometres; maximum stress 2.23 MPa.
Rotating-load FEM: maximum displacement 0.783 mm; von Mises stress 238 MPa.
The source treats rotating loads with a static solve; not a transient simulation.
Native CAD / solver deck / raw result fields: not verified.
Solver naming is inconsistent: RADIOSS in methods; Nastran in conclusion.

entries.title: Connecting rod: original and modified I
notes: Two dimensioned orthographic drawings, with material tables and FEM comparisons.

Kevlar49/epoxy stress: original 155.31 MPa; modified I 121.95 MPa.
Values refer to Table 4, not the separate validation model in Table 1.
